CREATE INDEX idx_date_dim_month_seq ON date_dim(d_month_seq);
CREATE INDEX idx_store_sales_ss_sold_date_sk_item_sk_store_sk ON store_sales(ss_sold_date_sk, ss_item_sk, ss_store_sk);

WITH filtered_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        i_category,
        i_class,
        i_brand,
        i_product_name,
        d_year,
        d_qoy,
        d_moy,
        s_store_id,
        SUM(COALESCE(ss_sales_price * ss_quantity, 0)) AS sumsales
    FROM 
        store_sales
    JOIN 
        date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    WHERE 
        d_month_seq BETWEEN 1217 AND 1228
    GROUP BY 
        i_category, i_class, i_brand, i_product_name, d_year, d_qoy, d_moy, s_store_id
),
ranked_sales AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (i_category)
        i_category,
        i_class,
        i_brand,
        i_product_name,
        d_year,
        d_qoy,
        d_moy,
        s_store_id,
        sumsales,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i_category ORDER BY sumsales DESC) AS rk
    FROM 
        filtered_sales
)
SELECT 
    i_category,
    i_class,
    i_brand,
    i_product_name,
    d_year,
    d_qoy,
    d_moy,
    s_store_id,
    sumsales,
    rk
FROM 
    ranked_sales
WHERE 
    rk <= 100
ORDER BY 
    i_category, i_class, i_brand, i_product_name, d_year, d_qoy, d_moy, s_store_id, sumsales, rk
LIMIT 100
